test_title: PYST 9: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F, and G, are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only two people sit to the left of A. Only three people sit between A and G. D sits second to the right of A. Only two people sit between D and C. E sits at some place to the right of F but at some place to the left of B.

How many people sit to the right of C?
solution:
As per the given information:

⇒ Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F, and G, are sitting in a row, facing the north. 

⇒ Only two people sit to the left of A. 

⇒ Only three people sit between A and G.
